name: gpu-four-tier
convention: Tier 1 = least of the attribute, tier 4 = most. Bounds are inclusive lower, exclusive upper (min <= x < max). Blank input -> blank tier.

tiers.label: Entry
tiers.meaning: Fine-tuning small models, LoRA, inference of <=13B; consumer and legacy cards

tiers.label: Mid
tiers.meaning: Workhorse training: 7-70B with sharding; A100/H100/L40S class

tiers.label: High
tiers.meaning: Large-model training and long context on fewer GPUs; H200, MI210-MI300A, Gaudi

tiers.label: Frontier
tiers.meaning: Frontier-scale training; Blackwell and MI300X/MI3xx class

cost.source: cost_mid_usd = mean of new_price_usd_low and new_price_usd_high (or whichever is present)

tiers.label: Premium
tiers.meaning: Blackwell-class, usually only sold in 8-GPU boards or racks

scarcity.source: scarcity_composite (mean of the three 1-5 channel indexes)

tiers.label: Available
tiers.meaning: Obtainable with some shopping around or quota requests

tiers.label: Constrained
tiers.meaning: Few providers, sales-led, waitlists or regional limits

tiers.label: Scarce
tiers.meaning: Effectively unobtainable for most buyers (EOL, export-restricted, HPC-only)
